page_title: DOR 3-0 FRE | Dortmund v Freiburg 09/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' Mateu Morey (Dortmund) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Harm Osmers blows his whistle for an infringement.
90+3' Mateu Morey (Dortmund) is flagged for offside.

90+2' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' Marco Reus will be replaced by Jadon Sancho (Dortmund).
88' Here's the change. Emre Can leaves the pitch and Mats Hummels (Dortmund) comes on as a substitute.
88' Edin Terzic has decided to make a change. Mateu Morey (Dortmund) replaces Ian Maatsen.
87' 3 - 0 Goal! Ian Maatsen swings the ball deep into the box and finds Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the bottom right corner. 3:0.
86' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Dortmund comes to nothing.
86' Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
84' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
84' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
82' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
80' Christian Streich prepares a substitution. Jordy Makengo is replaced by Christian Gunter (Freiburg).
79' Here comes a substitution. Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg) is brought on as a substitute for Roland Sallai.
79' Substitution. Julian Ryerson makes way for Marius Wolf (Dortmund).
78' Marco Reus (Dortmund) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal.
75' Marco Reus (Dortmund) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only rattles the right post.
73' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) receives a yellow card for infringement.
72' Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) latches onto a pass inside the box, steps inside his marker and smacks a shot against the left post.
72' Dortmund have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
71' Noah Atubolu makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the right-hand post by Marco Reus (Dortmund) after a cross from the side. Dortmund have been awarded a corner kick.
70' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) is penalised for holding. Harm Osmers signals a set piece.
66' It's time for a substitution. Julian Brandt (Dortmund) comes on in place of Jamie Bynoe-Gittens.
66' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
65' Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
59' Substitution. Michael Gregoritsch is replaced by Ritsu Doan (Freiburg).
59' Here is a change. Vincenzo Grifo is going off and Christian Streich gives the last tactical orders to Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg).
57' Emre Can (Dortmund) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
55' A rebound sits up nicely for Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) and he needs no second invitation to shoot from distance. The effort, however, balloons high over the bar and out for a goal kick.
53' Noah Atubolu pulls off a great save to deny Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
53' Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) sends a superb lead pass into the penalty area and finds Niclas Fullkrug, who fails to shoot.
51' Dangerous play by Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund). Harm Osmers blows his whistle for a foul. Freiburg have a free kick.
49' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

47' Noah Atubolu makes a brilliant save! Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the right side of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
46' Corner kick. Marco Reus (Dortmund) is ready to send the ball into the box.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+13' Harm Osmers blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+13' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Freiburg.
45+11' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) sprints into the box to get on the end of a cross and directs a shot goalwards that flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky!
45+10' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
45+7' 2 - 0 Goal! Niclas Fullkrug shows great vision to find Donyell Malen (Dortmund) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
45+4' The free kick from long range, taken by Freiburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45+3' Looks like Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
45' 12 additional min. will be played.
35' The corner from Marco Reus (Dortmund) is cleared away by the defence.
33' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but Noah Atubolu comes off his line to gather the ball.
32' The game is interrupted as Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) is flagged offside.
31' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) sends a long ball in, but Noah Atubolu comfortably gathers the ball.
26' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
26' Harm Osmers blows the whistle, Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) is penalised for a foul.
23' Manuel Gulde (Freiburg) is substituted due to injury. Christian Streich gives a chance to Attila Szalai.
21' Manuel Gulde (Freiburg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
21' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
16' 1 - 0 Donyell Malen (Dortmund) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort into the top right corner.
14' Harm Osmers shows a yellow card to Julian Ryerson (Dortmund), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

14' Noah Atubolu pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Donyell Malen (Dortmund) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the middle of the goal, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.
12' Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
10' Dortmund keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
8' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) takes a short corner kick.
7' Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
7' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Roland Sallai (Freiburg).
6' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) was too forceful with his tackle and Harm Osmers interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
4' Marco Reus (Dortmund) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
2' Harm Osmers blows his whistle and it's Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Freiburg will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Harm Osmers.
